notes.title: Patch 0.5.2
notes.notes:
Added more random events.
 New display: Collected objects now briefly show what has been picked up.
 Controls can now be viewed in the mainmenu.
 Mission briefings are only available once both players are ready in the lobby.
 The "Return to Menu" button for the client now appears later to prevent accidental clicks.
 Existing features have been partially optimized or improved.
 Visual improvement for enemies: They now track the player with their gaze.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.5.1
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Act II Overhaul: Act II has been completely reworked to enhance atmosphere and gameplay.
 Audio Feedback for Chases: A new sound effect now plays when you are being actively chased.
 Flashlight Stun: Players can now blind enemies with the flashlight once per level, rendering them temporarily immobile.

AI Improvements:

 Enemies can now hear players sprinting nearby.
 Further optimizations to AI behavior for smoother interactions.

Let me know if this works!

notes.title: Patch 0.5 – Now Available!
notes.notes:
🆕 New Content:

 New Act III Trailer – Now available on YouTube!
 Ghost Mode after Death – Players now respawn as ghosts and can move through doors.
[spoiler] New Boss Fight Mechanics in Act III![/spoiler] 

✨ Improvements:

 AI: Enemies patrol more actively and search players' last known positions.
 AI can reset if it gets stuck.
 New Animations: Movement, searching, chasing, and combat animations.
 Visual Updates to Menu and UI for a more polished design.
 Small Map Changes for more detail and atmosphere.
 Fireworks added in certain areas to celebrate the New Year.
 Storage Optimization: Reduced game size by 4 GB through asset cleanup.

⚠️ Known Issues:

 Shadows may flicker in some areas.
 Sync issues with poor player connections.
 Certain events may unintentionally trigger.
 AI reset may not always work as intended.

I hope you enjoy the updates! Thank you for your feedback and have fun playing!

notes.title: 🎄 Patch 0.5 Announcement + New Trailer for Act 3! 🎥
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, a big thank you for your support and the great feedback on the game!  
I’m excited to announce Patch 0.5! The update will be released before New Year’s and brings some exciting improvements.  

💥 Highlights of Patch 0.5: 
  
 New animations for players and enemies – including movement, combat, and patrol animations for a more immersive experience.
 AI overhaul – enemies patrol smarter, track last known positions, and reset if stuck.  
 Ghost mode – no more getting stuck after death; move freely as a ghost.  
 And more small tweaks!
 
I hope you’ll enjoy the upcoming changes! Wishing you all a Merry Christmas and a wonderful holiday season! 🎅✨  

Your developer,  
smi.

[previewyoutube=ZmTIvY5VXZU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch 0.4 Incoming – Act 3 Launches on December 6th!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I’m excited to share with you that Patch 0.4 will be released on December 6th! This update marks a major milestone: the final Act 3. Dive into the narrow alleys and face the last challenges of this journey.

Patch 0.4 not only introduces the new act but also brings numerous improvements and features:


 New NPCs and enemies for added variety.
 Hiding in lockers to evade threats.
 A stat tracking system to monitor your progress.
 Technical improvements and much more.



As a solo developer, I want to thank you for joining me on this journey. I’m eager to hear your feedback!

smi.

notes.title: Early Access Release – Patchnotes
notes.notes:
New Content & Features:
- Act 2 Levels: Brand new in Early Access! Explore a variety of new features. After completing Act 2, a hidden discovery awaits you upon re-entering the level.
- New Enemies: Prepare for fresh challenges with brand new enemy types.
- Brightness Option: You can now adjust the brightness to your preference.
- Game now mostly available in English: All text and subtitles have been translated into English. However, the voice lines remain in the original language, with translated English subtitles.
- Brighter Flashlight: The flashlight is now much brighter for improved visibility.
- Improved Enemy Animations: Enemies now move more fluidly and realistically.
- New Main Menu and Lobby: Enjoy a revamped main menu and an all-new lobby.
- New Voice Lines and Story Elements: Expanded storylines with new dialogue and narrative elements.
- New Achievements: More challenges for you to conquer.
- Longer Sprint Duration: Your character can now sprint for a longer period.
- Act 1 & Act 1.1: Minor tweaks for an enhanced player experience.
- New Random Events in Act 1: Randomized events add more variety and surprises.

[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixes:
- Post-Death Interaction: Fixed the issue where players could continue interacting after death.
- Important Items Not Syncing: Fixed synchronization issues with key items in multiplayer.

[hr][/hr]

Known Issues:
- Repeated voice prompt at corpse in bonus level: This bug currently always occurs.
- Desk chair not synced in the lobby: A specific desk chair causes visual inconsistencies.

[hr][/hr]
